fields.title: Software Engineering Intern
fields.description: Join a small product engineering team for a 12-week summer internship. You will ship customer-facing features, pair with a mentor, and take part in weekly design reviews. Applicants should be comfortable learning in a collaborative codebase.

fields.title: Climate Code Sprint
fields.description: A two-day team hackathon focused on practical climate data tools. Build a prototype using open datasets, get feedback from domain mentors, and present your work to a panel of engineers and researchers. Beginners are welcome.

fields.title: Designing Accessible Interfaces
fields.description: A hands-on workshop covering accessible interaction patterns, keyboard navigation, semantic HTML, and practical screen-reader testing. Leave with a small audited interface and a repeatable checklist for future projects.

fields.title: Student Developer Open House
fields.description: Meet engineers working across software, autonomy, and embedded systems. The evening includes short project talks, informal portfolio conversations, and time to learn about upcoming student roles.

fields.title: Data Platform Co-op
fields.description: Support a data infrastructure team building reliable pipelines for research and product analytics. The six-month co-op pairs scoped delivery work with code review, documentation, and regular mentorship.
